agency_name: North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services (NCDHHS)
mission: In collaboration with our partners, DHHS provides essential services to improve the health, safety and well-being of all North Carolinians.
user: The NCDHHS federal-grants coordinator, who reviews new federal funding opportunities each week, decides which are worth pursuing, and routes each one to the division that would own the application.

department_priorities.text: Deliver critical services to improve the health and well-being of North Carolinians: timely, coordinated implementation of NC Medicaid, SNAP, child welfare and child care services, supporting state and county DSS partners.
Transform rural health: strengthen and sustain programs, including the Rural Health Transformation Program, that enable rural communities to thrive, leveraging full federal investments.
Strengthen behavioral health crisis care and its coordination with the justice system.
Partner with key stakeholders to drive reforms that promote affordable and accessible health care for every North Carolinian.

strategic_priorities.name: Access to Care
strategic_priorities.description: Support North Carolinians' ability to safely, easily and fully access the services, programs and systems of care of NCDHHS and our partners.

objectives.text: Maintain access to health and human services in traditional and non-traditional settings to meet North Carolinians where they are.
Mitigate the social, cultural and literacy barriers that prevent North Carolinians from accessing health and human services.
Support affordable care options that North Carolinians can access easily.
Promote policies and remove barriers that improve North Carolinians' ability to access health and human services.

strategic_priorities.name: Whole Person Well-Being
strategic_priorities.description: Improve the well-being of North Carolinians by delivering comprehensive, high-quality services that address complex factors shaping outcomes for individuals and families.

objectives.text: Coordinate and integrate health and human services systems to support a healthy North Carolina.

Simplify the processes for families and individuals to navigate mental health, substance use disorder, intellectual/developmental disability (I/DD) and traumatic brain injury (TBI) systems and services.
Improve systems that address non-medical drivers of health such as access to healthy food.
Strengthen service delivery across all of NCDHHS points of contact by improving quality, efficiency, and reliability.

strategic_priorities.name: Transform and Modernize Health Care
strategic_priorities.description: Transform North Carolina's health care ecosystem by modernizing delivery, strengthening community and rural care, and optimizing strategic partnerships to expand access, improve outcomes and manage costs.

objectives.text: Align policy, finance and operations to manage costs and improve care.
Leverage volume purchasing power and develop strategic partnerships to increase access and reduce costs.
Leverage the expertise of state-operated health care facilities to support individuals with complex needs.
Promote a sustainable rural health delivery system that improves health outcomes for all North Carolinians.

strategic_priorities.name: Sustainable Workforce
strategic_priorities.description: Develop a skilled workforce that supports North Carolinians' health and well-being through training, career pathways and innovative strategies to attract and retain talent.

objectives.text: Develop and strengthen career pathways that address critical service gaps in health and human services workforces.
Provide all workforce members supporting the health and well-being of North Carolinians the necessary training, skills and compensation to deliver high-quality care and services.
Support individuals with employment barriers to obtain work, build financial security, increase independence, and strengthen social capital.
Leverage financial incentives, data and innovative practices to recruit and retain individuals to health and human services workforces.
Operate required workforce programs to efficiently and effectively meet the needs of eligible North Carolinians.

strategic_priorities.name: Organizational Excellence
strategic_priorities.description: Promote efficient and effective operations through continuous improvement, leveraging data, modernizing systems, using resources wisely and strengthening accountability and transparency across the department.

objectives.text: Modernize technology systems to enhance efficiency and collaboration.
Foster a culture of data-driven decision-making across NCDHHS.
Strengthen governance systems that promote accountability, manage risks and align activities with NCDHHS goals.
Steward state resources and continuously improve organizational processes and practices.

divisions.name: Division of Public Health
divisions.scope: disease prevention and surveillance, epidemiology, immunization, chronic disease, environmental health, maternal and child health, WIC, local health departments, public health preparedness, laboratory

divisions.name: Division of Mental Health, Developmental Disabilities and Substance Use Services
divisions.scope: mental health, substance use and opioid services, intellectual and developmental disabilities, traumatic brain injury, crisis services and 988, behavioral health for justice-involved people

divisions.name: Division of Health Benefits (NC Medicaid)
divisions.scope: Medicaid and NC Health Choice, managed care, Medicaid expansion, Healthy Opportunities, health care financing and affordability

divisions.name: Division of Child and Family Well-Being
divisions.scope: child and family health and nutrition programs, school health, early childhood well-being, child behavioral health

divisions.name: Division of Social Services
divisions.scope: child welfare, foster care, adoption, adult services, food and nutrition services (SNAP), work supports, county DSS partners

divisions.name: Division of Aging
divisions.scope: older adults, family caregivers, adult protective services, aging network, direct care workforce

divisions.name: Division of Child Development and Early Education
divisions.scope: child care subsidy and regulation, early childhood education, early childhood workforce

divisions.name: Office of Rural Health
divisions.scope: rural health, primary care access, critical access hospitals, rural health centers, Rural Health Transformation Program, health workforce recruitment

divisions.name: Division of Employment and Independence for People with Disabilities
divisions.scope: vocational rehabilitation, independent living, employment for people with disabilities

divisions.name: Divisions of Services for the Blind and for the Deaf and Hard of Hearing
divisions.scope: services for people who are blind, deaf, hard of hearing or deaf-blind

divisions.name: Division of Health Service Regulation
divisions.scope: licensure and certification of health care facilities, emergency medical services, certificate of need

divisions.name: Division of State Operated Healthcare Facilities
divisions.scope: state psychiatric hospitals, developmental centers, alcohol and drug treatment centers, neuro-medical treatment centers

divisions.name: Office of the Secretary and central administration
divisions.scope: department-wide data, technology, budget, federal funds tracking, workforce, operations
